limits: Hardware is a dated npu-smi/lscpu snapshot, not a claim of current resources or continuous idle.
HCCS is a reported connection class; link number, lanes, negotiated speed and achieved bandwidth remain unknown.
Mesh axis sets are derived from observed parameter coordinates; they are not traces of which collectives actually executed.
Muon assignment PG metadata only describes Muon assignment, not an alteration of the model HSDP mesh.
Local references are provenance locators only: original snapshots and target files can contain unrelated private fields and must not be published wholesale.
No individual training sample, private YAML, weights, IP addresses, or bus-ID-based bandwidth inference included.
